cards.text: Would you rather have a cosy night in or a wild night out?
Would you rather be able to read minds or teleport?
Would you rather a partner who makes you laugh or one who spoils you?
Would you rather travel the world for a year or have your dream home?
Would you rather get a good-morning text or a good-night call?
Would you rather dance in the rain or watch the stars together?
Would you rather have breakfast in bed or a candlelit dinner?
Would you rather be adventurous or romantic on a first date?
Would you rather have a beach holiday or a mountain getaway?
Would you rather always know the truth or always be surprised?
Would you rather a slow dance or a road-trip singalong?
Would you rather get flowers unexpectedly or a heartfelt letter?
Would you rather have superpowers or unlimited money?
Would you rather cook together or order in and chill?
Would you rather a partner who's spontaneous or one who plans everything?
Would you rather stargaze all night or sleep in till noon together?
Would you rather be complimented on your smile or your eyes?
Would you rather relive your best memory or create a new one right now?
Would you rather have a movie marathon or a game night?
Would you rather whisper a secret or shout a compliment?
Would you rather have coffee dates or midnight snack dates?
Would you rather someone remember your birthday or your favourite song?
Would you rather a surprise gift or a surprise trip?
Would you rather hold hands on a walk or cuddle on the couch?
